background_story: Zaiden was a remarkable beetle who underwent a complete transformation from egg to adult. As a holometabolic insect, he went through four distinct life stages: egg, larva, pupa, and adult. Born in a cozy nest beneath the roots of an ancient tree, Zaiden's life began as a tiny egg. He hatched into a hungry larva, feeding on decaying wood and growing rapidly. As he outgrew his skin, Zaiden entered a dramatic transformation, encasing himself in a pupal shell. Within this sheltered space, his body reorganized into the adult form. Finally, he emerged as a stunning iridescent beetle, his wings unfolding like a work of art. Zaiden's incredible metamorphosis was a testament to the wonders of holometabolism, a process that allowed him to thrive in a world of constant change.
